milestones.goal: J1-J3 work end to end in a Switch room on EC2
Real demo world, Slack with teammates, coda, docs, video, submission

tasks.title: Done-when parser and contest matrix (pure code)
tasks.objective: Extract the checklist from an issue body and build the matrix rows, CI-vs-claim flags and reading disagreements from collected facts

tasks.title: GitHub collector and `bakeoff matrix` CLI
tasks.objective: Fetch issue, linked open PRs, CI conclusions, files and body claims; print the matrix for OWNER/REPO ISSUE
acceptance: WHEN `bakeoff matrix OWNER/REPO N` runs on a live issue THE SYSTEM SHALL print one column per open PR closing it

tasks.title: Bakeoff MCP server: readings and merge_pick
tasks.objective: stdio MCP tools done_when, contest_matrix, pr_diff, record_reading, merge_pick with a single-use decision per contest

tasks.title: Room template, Switch bridge client and intake watcher
tasks.objective: Watcher finds contests and creates one Switch room per contest from templates/bakeoff.room.yaml through the agent bridge, then posts the matrix

tasks.title: Switch server, controller and three agents on EC2
tasks.objective: Headless Switch (server, gateway, Mattermost) and the agent controller with bakeoff-checker, bakeoff-second, bakeoff-merge online; runbook written
acceptance: an agent replies in a room; the bridge API posts a message
verify: observe: bakeoff-checker replies in a Switch room on the EC2 server
tasks.rollback: stop the compose stack; instance can be stopped

tasks.title: Wire Bakeoff into Switch end to end
tasks.objective: Install bakeoff on the box, MCP config for the agents, merge agent with approvals and maintainer-only addressing, watcher as a service; one contest runs end to end
verify: observe: a contest room opens, both agents record readings, approval card, merge and decline notes land on GitHub

tasks.title: Backup take of the working path
tasks.objective: Screen-record one full contest run as soon as J1-J3 work
verify: observe: backup recording of a full contest run saved

tasks.title: Demo world: real issue and four agents' PRs
tasks.objective: CI workflow on this repo; a real issue with a Done-when list; four PRs written by Claude Code, Kimi Code, Pi and OpenCode, each saying which agent wrote it
acceptance: the issue shows four open PRs closing it, each with CI results
verify: observe: issue has four open PRs from four agents with CI results

tasks.title: Slack bridge, friends and three rehearsals
tasks.objective: Register the Slack bridge, link the friends, run the demo flow three times with resets
acceptance: demo flow runs 3 times in a row
verify: observe: demo flow ran three times in Slack with resets

tasks.title: Personal coda: which homepage should I ship
tasks.objective: Homepage repo with a brief and a CI must-have check; candidates' screenshots posted in the room; owner picks; merge deploys to GitHub Pages
acceptance: WHEN the owner's pick is approved THE SYSTEM SHALL merge it and the live page shows the picked design
verify: observe: picked homepage live on GitHub Pages after approval
tasks.notes: [2026-11-05 start] T06's last check (a human approving the merge card) waits on the builder's Slack setup; T10's build work does not depend on it

tasks.title: Security pass and fresh-eyes review
tasks.objective: Secrets scan, token scopes, merge_pick refusal paths, fresh reviewer on the diff
acceptance: no secrets in repo or logs; blocking findings fixed
verify: observe: fresh review report saved in .prod-build/reports
tasks.notes: [2026-11-05 start] review findings fixed now, before the Slack run; T06's last check waits on the builder

tasks.title: README, docs and blog draft
tasks.objective: README with judge card, how Bakeoff uses Switch, run it yourself; blog post for first-time Switch users
acceptance: README sections exist and match the run
verify: observe: README read top to bottom against a clean clone

tasks.title: Final take
tasks.objective: Record the final video from the frozen build, under 3 minutes
verify: observe: final video under 180 seconds exported

tasks.title: Submit
tasks.objective: Form answers, pb.py submit check, links opened signed out
verify: observe: submit check passes and form submitted

tasks.title: Slack bot token and workspace id
tasks.objective: Builder installs the Slack app and stores xoxb token + workspace id
verify: manual: xoxb token in SSM /switch-demo/slack-bot-token and workspace id given

tasks.title: Friends join Slack for recording
tasks.objective: 2-3 friends join the workspace and the recording session
verify: manual: 2-3 friends joined Slack and booked a 30 min slot

tasks.title: Upload video, Wispr card, press submit
tasks.objective: Builder uploads the video (public/unlisted), screenshots the Wispr usage card, submits the form
verify: manual: form submitted with video link and Wispr card
